name: Honest Sell Prices
summary: Set how much your crops, animal products and artisan goods are worth, each group on its own, from a little less to a lot more.
logoPrompt: A small wooden shipping crate with a ripe parsnip, a white egg and a wedge of cheese inside, a brass price tag tied to its side
description: **Honest Sell Prices lets you choose what your crops, animal products and artisan goods sell for, each group with its own setting.**
- Three settings: crops, animal products and fixed-price artisan goods.
- Each one at 75 %, 100 % (the normal game, default), 125 % or 150 %.
- Counts for the shipping bin and shops; profession bonuses and quality apply on top.
- Wine, juice, jelly, pickles and dried fruit follow the price of the crop they are made from.
- No shop item can be resold for more than it costs.
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then unzip the file into your `Mods` folder. Pick the levels in the generated `config.json` or in Generic Mod Config Menu.
- Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer. Made for Stardew Valley 1.6.
- Built carefully from the documented formats of Stardew Valley 1.6 and Content Patcher.
- New prices count for items harvested or made afterwards; items you already have may keep their old price.
- Carrot, summer squash, broccoli and powdermelon keep vanilla prices.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
